blackwell-2gpu-cfg-parallel.description: Blackwell 2-GPU CFG-parallel + cuDNN-SDPA SGLang-Diffusion Cosmos3 T2I profile.
blackwell-2gpu-cfg-parallel.serve_args: --model-type diffusion --warmup-mode server --attention-backend torch_cudnn_sdpa --tp-size 1 --cfg-parallel-size 2 --dit-layerwise-offload false --performance-mode speed --enable-torch-compile false
blackwell-2gpu-cfg-parallel.notes: Measured on 4xB200 2026-09-13, two interleaved rounds. Against the previous `--tp-size 2 --attention-backend fa` command: 0.765 -> 0.576s and 0.797 -> 0.575s, about -25%, taking the cell from losing to vLLM-Omni (0.651-0.662s) to beating it. TWO changes, both measured separately. (1) CFG parallelism instead of TP: the case is guidance_scale 6.0 -- true CFG, two branches -- so one branch per GPU with the DiT replicated and one combine per step beats splitting every layer and paying an all-reduce per layer (0.765 -> 0.584, 0.797 -> 0.617). It is also what sglang's own runtime would choose: cosmos3 inherits auto_enable_cfg_parallel=True with get_auto_cfg_parallel_degree(2)->2 and _model_default_uses_cfg()->True, but `--tp-size 2` made _has_explicit_parallel_policy() true and suppressed it. The sibling Cosmos3 T2V profile already uses CFG parallel; T2I was the odd one out. (2) torch_cudnn_sdpa instead of fa, on top of that: 0.584 -> 0.576 and 0.617 -> 0.575, same sign both rounds, and far steadier -- its repeats spread 0.9% (0.572-0.577) where fa's swung 0.579-0.792. Exact softmax, same precision class as fa, and the backend vLLM-Omni serves this case with. fa2 does not run at all: there is no native transformer for it, so the loader tries a Diffusers fallback and refuses under tp>1. NOTE: at tp_size=1 that refusal no longer guards this cell -- the harness scans the server log for the fallback markers instead.

blackwell-cudnn.description: Blackwell vLLM-Omni profile for cosmos3_nano_t2i_720p using cuDNN attention.
blackwell-cudnn.notes: Blackwell attention choice, measured on this box 2026-09-12. FLASH_ATTN is a Hopper-only precompiled kernel -- vLLM-Omni refuses it on sm_100 with 'FLASH_ATTN was explicitly selected but is unsupported'. FLASHINFER_ATTN starts but dies under torch.compile on dynamic shapes (`AsPythonConstantNotImplementedError: SymNodeVariable() is not a constant` in the FlashInfer backend's _ensure_plan), observed on qwen-image and cosmos3 t2v; it is fine for the static image cases (zimage, flux), which are deliberately left on it. CUDNN_ATTN is exact softmax, the same precision class as the kernels the other frameworks run here, measured at 2.741s on qwen-image (vs TRTLLM_ATTN 3.274s) and already the backend minimax-h3 serves with on this box. Also drops --stage-configs-path: vLLM-Omni 0.29 rejects it outright (`stage_configs_path is no longer supported; use deploy_config instead`), and upstream's own cosmos3 deploy file says the T2I/video checkpoints must keep the default single-stage diffusion fallback -- so cfg-parallel and guardrails move to the first-class flags rather than to a new YAML. The old YAML also pinned enforce_eager, which silently ran this competitor compile-off against the policy.

trtllm-visual.reason: Hangs at startup on the current Cosmos3-Nano checkpoint: trtllm-serve reaches 'Orchestrator is creating IPC executor' / 'using MpiPoolSession to spawn MPI processes' and then produces no output at all -- 40 min in the matrix, and 20 min each at tp=1 and tp=2 in a dedicated probe, so it is not a multi-GPU path issue. The startup log warns 'You are using a model of type cosmos3_omni to instantiate a model of type cosmos3': the checkpoint was re-uploaded 2026-08-26 and declares cosmos3_omni, which tensorrt-llm 1.3.0rc26 does not know. Marked failed rather than left supported so a run does not spend 40 minutes per attempt reaching the same hang. Re-test when trtllm adds cosmos3_omni; the profile is kept below.
